## Liquid Glass Orb

The orb visualizer (`src/orb/effect.wgsl`, and the parameter model, uniform
packing and WebGPU renderer derived from it) is adapted from the Liquid Orb
Editor.

- Source: https://github.com/LerSent001/orb
- Licence: MIT

What we took: the WGSL effect shader, the eleven presets and their parameter
ranges, the uniform buffer layout, and the structure of the WebGPU render loop.

What we changed: the renderer was rewritten to pause when offscreen or hidden,
to cap device pixel ratio, to honour `prefers-reduced-motion`, and to report
every failure so the widget can fall back to a DOM waveform. The state and audio
reactivity layer in `src/orb/reactive.ts` is original work and is not derived
from the upstream project.

What we did not take: the editor application, the Toolcraft UI component
library vendored inside it, the Metal shader, and the SwiftUI exporter.
